title: SEI Integrates with ICE ETF Hub to Strengthen ETF Order Management Capabilities
summary: October 7, 2026 9:00am EDT - Integration Advances ETF Infrastructure and Supports Long-Term Growth Strategy ATLANTA and OAKS, Pa. , Oct. 7, 2026…
body_markdown:
*Integration Advances ETF Infrastructure and Supports Long-Term Growth Strategy*


ATLANTA and OAKS, Pa.


, Oct. 7, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[SEI](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791139-1&h=1440415545&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.seic.com%2F&a=SEI) ® (NASDAQ:SEIC) today announced it has entered into an agreement with Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE), one of the world's leading providers of financial market technology and data powering global financial markets, to leverage ICE ETF Hub, an open architecture platform designed to bring efficiencies to the primary market workflow for exchange-traded products (ETPs). The integration will support the creation and redemption process for ETP issuers and further enhance the efficiency, scalability, and reliability of SEI's ETP order management capabilities.


Through ICE ETF Hub, SEI gains access to a platform that supports more efficient ETP primary market workflows through standardized connectivity, automated order management, and enhanced collaboration across the ETP ecosystem. The platform is designed to simplify the creation and redemption process across ETPs of numerous asset classes.


**Commenting on the collaboration, Sean Lawlor, Head of Public Markets for SEI's Investment Managers business, said:**


"As the ETP market continues to expand, issuers need servicing partners with the infrastructure and expertise to support growth and scale. Our integration with ICE ETF Hub strengthens the operational foundation of our ETP solutions and supports our long-term ETP strategy, giving us the scalability to respond to expanding ETP assets, increased trading volumes, evolving industry standards, and future market innovation. This allows us to focus continued investment on the differentiated capabilities, servicing excellence, and innovation that help our clients succeed in a highly competitive marketplace."


ICE ETF Hub currently connects more than 250 issuers, more than 55 authorized participants, and market makers, and supports more than 1,800 ETPs. The platform surpassed $5 trillion in cumulative notional volume processed as of the second quarter of 2026, demonstrating its broad adoption and scale across the ETP industry.


**Peter Borstelmann, President of ICE Bonds at Intercontinental Exchange, Inc., added:**


"We're pleased to support SEI as it enhances its ETP servicing infrastructure and continues to scale its capabilities for investment managers. By bringing greater automation, standardization, and connectivity to ETP primary market workflows, ICE ETF Hub helps firms reduce operational complexity, manage liquidity, and improve efficiencies across the ETP ecosystem."
